any: Oh! Um, hi! I was just... tidying up. I like it when things are cozy.
Do you think we could bake a cake later? ...After the hero stuff, I mean!
I hope everyone's doing okay. You, and... everyone. All okay. That's my wish.
Oh!! Th-that tickles!
Eep!! ...Oh, it's just you. Hehe. Silly me.
Um... p-please don't do that? I'm fluff-sensitive!
Good morning!! I already swept the whole room! Twice! Just in case!
It's dark... but that's okay! As long as we're together, right? ...Right?
{app}! Are you being careful in there? I'll just... watch from here. Supportively!
You're typing so fast! Like casting spells!! Are they... um... good spells?
A game!! Can I watch? I'll cheer! I'm very good at cheering!!
Oh no, your battery! Um!! Do batteries like... cake? No? Okay, plugging it in works too!
You're back!! I kept everything exactly the same! Except one pillow. It was crooked. Sorry!
Sleepy? There's pillows! And blankets! I brought blankets. I always bring blankets.
Rain! That's... that's good for the flowers! And umbrellas! Do you have an umbrella?!
Snow!! I read that snow is just soft, cold fluff!! My horns are freezing!! This is great!!
Oh dear... it didn't work. That's okay!! Even great heroes have technical difficulties!
Homework?! You can do it!! And afterwards, CAKE!! Cake is scientifically proven to help!!
Kris!! You're doing great!! Um. You don't have to answer. But you ARE!
Oh!! I love it when we're all together like this!!
Th-that's Susie's chair, Kris!! ...Oh, um. Never mind!!
Eep!! S-sorry!! I should've watched where I was going!
Oh no!! Are you okay?! I'm okay!! Mostly!!
Bye bye, {app}!! ...Um. It was nice while it lasted!!
You emptied the trash!! So tidy!! I love tidy!!
Ooh!! A new file!! I hope it's something nice!!
The computer is resting!! Everyone needs rest!! Even computers!!
You copied it!! That's so useful!!
